# Android tooling unit linker harness: independent static review

**Verdict: PASS. No remaining static findings. Actual current probe and build execution remain pending.**

Candidate `4fb7a80eacc598a786b4b98c809d1df24a1b02ee`, branch `android-studio-task/1-parallel-sync-integration`, tree `9659baeb98fcf7111435169eb04490ba3952989d`. The exact seven source exclusions, clean commit/index/worktree/untracked scope, and all **4,730** file digests match the frozen combined snapshot. **103** nested port evidence files remain within the source guard.

The helper SHA-256 is `042e58723429235b722a41c4b342ba0c054de734e00a58fcc45dbaea5c173918`. Reversing only the declared private receipt/probe directory and output label substitutions plus the exact expected final unit artifact substitution reproduces the independently reviewed P1 helper `4c1afa55f6bce97b187de02f0049e91004487d3a798eb198f1aa152f146909a9` byte for byte. The actual compiler remains `/usr/bin/cc`; no linker inputs, flags, or behavior were changed.

Redirection requires exactly one separate `-o` and an exact allowlisted final output or private probe path. All other vectors pass through unchanged. The selected vector is cloned and only its output value changes. Existing output paths, including dangling symlinks, and existing PID-owned redirected outputs are refused. Receipts use `create_new`. The real linker's standard output and error are inherited without manufacturing Cargo messages. Real nonzero status propagates; after receipt creation its incomplete owned output is removed. I/O and publication errors fail. Success requires a regular linked file and successfully publishes a symlink without replacing the original path.

The helper preserves actual `OsString` argument bytes. Receipts serialize lossy UTF-8 strings, so runtime review must confirm actual argument vectors are UTF-8 before using receipt strings as exact identities. A receipt I/O failure can leave an unpublished owned output; it cannot produce a successful helper status. The controlled serialized lease avoids simultaneous publication and these helpers are scoped to this environment.

No Cargo, rustc, Gradle, helper, probe, app or cache operation was run by this reviewer. No product source, tests, fixtures, Git state, original raw logs or receipts were changed. Only these external review reports were written. Runtime, full app/native, CI, test parity, feature reviews, performance and IDE completion require their own evidence.
